notes: The supplied subject some is added under rule 17, while the recast second clause's relative that goes to its waw under the same rule (no explicit subject pronoun stands in that clause).
מֵעֵבֶר לַיָּם writes a word for each of מִן and עֵבֶר, so rule 2 splits them and the לְ is unrepresented under rule 40.
הִיא is realized by the demonstrative expression the same rather than a bare pronoun (rule 18); the copula of the following clause joins the predicate name (rule 20).
